edbDesc: The pressure of a vapor in thermodynamic equilibrium with its condensed phases in a closed system. All liquids and solids have a tendency to evaporate into a gaseous form, and all gases have a tendency to condense back to their liquid or solid form.
title: Vapour Pressure
pickWhy: A general property of liquids, not a specific effect; Raoult's law and the refrigerator cards already use it.
